sample_reviews.author: Mark T
sample_reviews.text: Peter sorted our boiler out quickly and efficiently. Very professional, explained everything clearly and left the place spotless. Highly recommend.

sample_reviews.author: Sarah L
sample_reviews.text: Called Peter for an emergency gas issue and he was with us within the hour. Fantastic service, very knowledgeable and reasonably priced.

sample_reviews.author: Dave R
sample_reviews.text: Great plumbing work done on our bathroom. Turned up on time, did a tidy job and the price was fair. Would definitely use again.

brand.usp: Peter Dundon Gas and Plumbing Services Ltd brings reliable, Gas Safe registered expertise to homes and businesses across Liverpool, delivering honest workmanship and transparent pricing every time.
brand.about_paragraph: I'm Peter Dundon, and I've built my business on a simple principle — honest, reliable gas and plumbing work you can count on. Based at Brunswick Dock in the heart of Liverpool, I cover the whole city and surrounding areas, tackling everything from boiler installations to emergency call-outs. As a Gas Safe registered engineer, your safety is always my number one priority.
